draft.summary: Educational / decision guide for what-is-crm using softwareglimpse-guide-template-v1 + block recipe for topicType=fundamental. Optimize for intent completeness — not word count.

sections.heading: Direct answer
sections.body: Answer the search intent in under 30 seconds. Prefer DirectAnswer + KeyTakeaways blocks. For selection guides, Quick Answer renders in the hero left column (belowCta) beside the framework visual.

sections.heading: Content block recipe
sections.body: Emit GuideContentBlock[] in this order (skip only with justification): direct-answer → key-takeaways → step → crm-types → faq → related-content → interactive-cta. Render via GuideBlocksRenderer + guide-visuals (pastel multi-color icon chips, TipCallout, filled native diagrams). Never invent catalogue products; reference existing slugs only. Do not duplicate Best / Finder / Calculator pages — teach how to decide, then link upward. Template rules: Use template softwareglimpse-guide-template-v1 — reuse GuideHero, GuideBlocksRenderer, GuideSidebar, guide-visuals. | Emit GuideContentBlock[] from GUIDE_BLOCK_RECIPES for the topicType — not thin H2 essays. | Selection/buying guides: put Quick Answer in the hero left column under CTAs (belowCta) beside the framework visual. | Use pastel multi-color icon chips (GUIDE_ICON_TONE_KEYS) — never monochrome-blue-only icon rows. | Fill visual cards with native UI (roadmap, goals, integrations, cost donut) — no sparse PNG letterboxing. | Tips use .sg-guide-tip / TipCallout (left accent bar). Must-have vs nice-to-have use green/purple list cards. | Sidebar: numbered In this guide TOC, solid blue Finder CTA, recommended tools, related, newsletter. | Commercial visits via SoftwareCta / /go/{slug} only — never paste raw affiliate URLs. | No invented scores, dollar totals, research hours, or affiliate-ordered rankings.

sections.heading: Decision framework
sections.body: For selection/buying-guide topics: include interactive checklist, weighted criteria, trial plan, and Finder CTA. For fundamentals: diagram + how-it-works + examples. For implementation: timeline + checklists + risks.

sections.heading: Common mistakes
